in_hindi.name: सुम्मय्या

in_pashto.name: سميه
in_pashto.meaning: سميه د لوړ او برتر معنی څخه دي

in_english.name: Summayya
in_english.meaning: Summayya means exalted, elevated, or lofty in meaning
in_english.long_meaning: The name Summayya originates from the Arabic root 'sīn-mīm-yā', meaning exalted, elevated, or lofty. In Islamic tradition, Summayya is considered a name of noble and sublime connotations, reflecting virtues of high moral character. Historically, it has been used to signify individuals of elevated status or spiritual distinction.

data.cultural_impact: Summayya's name holds significant cultural importance in Islamic history as she is the mother of the Prophet's granddaughter, Fatimah Al-Zahra (PBUH), who is greatly revered in the Islamic tradition as the "Mother of the Believers". Her name has been a subject of various artistic, literary and scholarly works throughout Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Summayya is considered a model of faith and perseverance in the face of adversity. According to Islamic tradition, Summayya was married off to one of the Prophet's companions, who was neglectful towards his wife and daughter, and ultimately, raised Zaid ibn Haritha as his own son, disowning Summayya and her daughter Fatimah. Despite the hardships she faced, Summayya remained steadfast in her faith, and her tale serves as an inspiration for Muslims to never give up on their beliefs and to maintain their dignity and patience in times of hardship.
